verdict.rationale: SendGrid's documented 'Sandbox mode' is a per-request flag that validates a Mail Send call without delivering the email. That is a dry-run on the live account, not an isolated sandbox environment separated from production data. No evidence shows a separate test environment, test account, or data isolation, so this related-but-different control earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
